title: Chapter 618 - 618 Instigator; Attack!
content:
Chapter 618 - 618 Instigator; Attack!

Chapter 618 - 618 Instigator; Attack!

618 Instigator; Attack!

‘If I take the initiative to give it, even if it’s a treasure, you can take it.

‘I didn’t give it to you, yet you reached out to take it? Then I’ll break your hands!’

As for the fair-skinned man, he felt that he was worse than a dog…

In fact, he was not as good as the Heavenly Hound.

Of course, Lin Fan did not use such an analogy.

…

In Canna’s live broadcast room…

“Oh my god!” the host exclaimed. “Look at what Govindo is doing. He actually wants to snatch Lin Fan’s food!”

Andros: [Govindo, stop messing around!]

Menlo: [Govindo, what do you want?]

Mond: [God! I actually worshiped Govindo before this. Was I crazy? I actually admired a person who likes to do stupid things.]

Archies: [Luckily, Lin Fan held back.]

…

Held back?

That was right!

This was what everyone in Canna thought.

That was because they had already seen the video of Lin Fan displaying his divine power through live streams or recordings.

He was well-deserved of his title as a god! He was number one in the world!

If God Lin had not held back, Govindo would have turned into ashes long ago!

…

Compared to the sighs of the people from Canna, the other countries were praying silently. They prayed that their heroes would not do anything stupid and provoke Lin Fan!

…

Govindo lay on the ground and spat out a mouthful of blood.

However, he was not frightened by this.

On the contrary, he became even more ferocious and vicious.

“What are you guys waiting for?” Govindo shouted.

“This is an abandoned island. It’s full of rocks, and there’s no food!

“He has so much roasted meat in his hands. Don’t you want to eat it? How long has it been since you guys ate meat?

“In the future, there won’t be any of it!

“Moreover, he has a dog beside him. Dog meat is also very delicious!

“This is a rock island. There’s no food here!

“Perhaps this will be our only source of food for a period of time!

“He’s very strong, but there are so many of us. Or will you let all the food end up in his hands?

“Do you want to starve to death?”

These words resonated with everyone.

That was right!

There would not be such barbecued meat in the future.

Lin Fan was very strong, but if they did not defeat him now, they might not have another chance in the future.

Thus, many people looked at each other as if they had made a choice.

At this moment, Lin Fan swallowed a piece of meat and spat out two words, “So noisy!”

As soon as he finished speaking, Lin Fan slapped the air.

Like a falling mountain, a palm-shaped hole appeared where Govindo was.

Govindo’s body exploded into a pile of minced meat.

Lin Fan had given him a chance to live. If he did not want it, then so be it!

The entire scene was deathly silent!

The aroma of meat in the air was completely covered by the thick smell of blood.

Everyone present had already opened treasure chests and obtained powerful strength. They felt that they had become superhumans.

However, after seeing this scene, they could not help but be terrified.

Especially those who had other ideas, a thin layer of sweat appeared on their foreheads.

If they had made the first move, what would have happened?

At this moment, an emotionless voice sounded.

[Govindo of Canna has died. The lifespan of the people of Canna has been reduced by five years.]

Suddenly, the Void Gate where the country of Canna was located released a dense black gas.

Then…

Some people who were walking on the road suddenly fell to the ground and did not get up again.

The miners who were mining suddenly disappeared underground after the cave collapsed.

Some drunk people crawled to the window and vomited before falling down.

…

In the live broadcast room of Canna…

“No!” the host exclaimed.

Allen: [Why? Why did Govindo say something like that?]

McGee: [It’s over, everything is over!]

Murphy: [Govindo, why did you drag us down even if you wanted to die?]

…

Mordmohan was also shocked by Lin Fan’s strength. She stuttered, “Abraham… just how strong is he?”

“He’s powerful!” Abraham said in admiration. “His power is unpredictable!”

The night gradually darkened.

Lin Fan did not take out his sleeping bag to sleep today. Instead, he sat on a rock and looked up at the starry night sky. He was extremely satisfied.

In the blink of an eye, the next day arrived.

Yesterday, many people did not have any food on them. After starving for an entire day, their stomachs were a little flat.

Therefore, when the sky was completely bright, they could not hold it in any longer. They first searched the rock island. After confirming that there was no food, they looked at the endless sea.

Some people went to the seaside to look for traces of fish.

Unfortunately, the waves were too fast and the water was too deep. They did not find anything at all.

Therefore, some people simply jumped into the sea, hoping to catch fish in the sea with their speed and strength that far exceeded ordinary people.

Not long after, a man popped his head out, holding an arm-long fish in his hand. His entire face was full of smiles as he slowly swam toward the shore.

Right at this moment…

A pitch-black python suddenly appeared behind him. It opened its bloody mouth and swallowed him.

Blood soon dyed the beach red.

It was terrifying!

There were actually monsters in the sea!

An emotionless voice rang out at the scene.

[The chosen one of Luo Country, Alexander Menlo, has died. The area of Luo Country has been reduced by 10%!]

Some of the people standing by the sea hurriedly ran toward the middle of the rock island.

They were all frightened by the monster in the sea.

The black python that was hiding in the sea seemed to be addicted to eating. It popped its head out again and opened its bloody mouth to bite the nearest brown-skinned man.

“Master!” Sam shouted.

Lin Fan did not even bat an eyelid as he pulled out the Star Meteorite Sword from his waist.

A sharp sword light shot out and instantly sliced through the black python’s head.

In the next moment, it was as though a huge rock had fallen on the black python’s entire head. It was smashed heavily onto the ground, making a muffled sound.

The black python’s corpse fell straight into the sea.

The blood dyed a large area of seawater red.

At the same time, an emotionless voice sounded at the scene.

[The first to kill a level-seven Sea Python. You’ve obtained a level-seven treasure Chest.]

[The first to kill a level-seven Sea Python. The number of endangered animals in Hua Nation has increased by 10%.]

Then, a level-seven treasure chest appeared in front of Lin Fan.

With a wave of his hand, the treasure chest opened.

[You’ve obtained 500 Constitution points. Do you want to use them?]

Then, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a special red packet—5,000 Constitution points.]

The power continued to surge.

His strength increased once again!
